title: RuleCard
description: Deterministic, refutable fault-detection/diagnosis rule card. Satisfies S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 2 rubric items 8 and 10 and FAULT_DISCOVERY_REQUIREMENTS.md FR-1 (schema freeze per FR-9). Free text is permitted ONLY in rationale fields; refutation results are adjudicated per REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md. Authoritative goal (verbatim): 构建一个 Agent，能够从源代码中发现固件/软件故障机制，并推导出相应的故障检测/诊断规则。

mechanism_id.description: Mechanism identifier minted at promotion time from the source hypothesis (FR-1 field).

hypothesis_ref.description: MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS_SCHEMA.json hypothesis_id this RuleCard was derived from; that hypothesis MUST have status promoted_to_rule.

fault_class.description: Fault family. Wave-1 families: condition_config_gated | init_submit_pairing | existence_absence | direct_flow_presence (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 8).

goal_item.description: Goal item(s) under the authoritative goal (verbatim): 构建一个 Agent，能够从源代码中发现固件/软件故障机制，并推导出相应的故障检测/诊断规则。 Wave-1 cites goal items 1-3, never redefining them (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 8).

corpus_case.description: Corpus case id: C1 | C4 | C5 | C6 per WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md section 3. C6 is the negative control and carries the expected-refutation case of REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md section 3.

lineage.description: Repository lineage (A/B/C per WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md); single-variant only (GA-4 fence).

schema_version.description: Schema freeze id of this RuleCard contract (RULECARD_SCHEMA.json $id plus freeze revision).

trigger_conditions.description: Structured deterministic predicates ONLY (rubric item 10). At least one predicate is required; free text is permitted ONLY in the optional rationale field of a predicate.

predicate_id.description: Predicate identifier within the RuleCard (e.g. P1, P2).

kind.description: condition_text = enclosing conditional-chain text; config_symbol = build-config symbol state (Kconfig/-D/manifest); call_reachable = proven call/reachability edge; definition_absent = enumerated absence of a definition (E4/E7); definition_present = presence of a definition; value_comparison = comparison over out-of-band build values (G8-policed, never load-bearing alone).

statement.description: Formal-ish deterministic predicate statement over the referenced facts (machine-evaluable wording); NOT a free-text narrative.

negatable.description: True when the predicate has a well-defined deterministic negation that a refutation protocol step may target.

rationale.description: Optional free-text justification. This is the ONLY free-text field of a predicate.

evidence.description: Load-bearing evidence chain as canonical FactRecord refs. Each ref's trust_class MUST be inherited unchanged from the fact log for its fact_id (a mismatch is an E1 violation and invalidates the RuleCard). T2 refs are never load-bearing (E2); single-line/fragment claims require at least 2-surface cross-check before load-bearing use (E3).

derived_from.description: Evidence surfaces the RuleCard derivation actually used (values as in FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json evidence_surface).

certainty.description: Overall derivation certainty; degraded is admitted only for non-load-bearing labeling (E2/E6).

k1_mediated.description: Wave-1 RuleCards are issued only through the K1 evidence gateway; always true.

polarity.description: positive = asserts the mechanism/trigger holds; negative = asserts absence/detection-by-absence; lower_bound = partial detection admissible only as a lower bound (G7).

forbidden_overclaims.description: MUST be non-empty (FR-7 and the two-part C1 separation, WAVE1_CORPUS_MATRIX.md section 2): wherever runtime occurrence is not source-provable, the RuleCard explicitly lists the claims it does NOT make (e.g. queue full occurred; submission was lost at runtime; any resource-exhaustion claim).

steps.description: Executable refutation steps, each replayable under the recorded freeze_id.

action.description: query_substrate_via_k1 = replay a K1-gated substrate query; independent_crosscheck = run an independent channel (grep/rg, clang -E, manifest diff); inspect_condition = re-inspect the conditional chain (condition text, run-pinned); construct_counterexample_search = deterministic search for an input/location that violates the rule.

inputs.description: Executable inputs for the action (surface, exact query/command, target file and lines, freeze_id, oracle handle).

expected_two_outcomes.description: A-priori observation semantics of THIS STEP. This is NOT the superseded two-outcome refutation RESULT wording (rule_falsified | oracle_falsified) from FR-1; results are adjudicated per REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md.

oracle_requirement.description: Oracle needed to adjudicate the protocol (e.g. blind planted oracle held by the custodian; commit-derived ground truth; field log; none). Must be consistent with oracle_provenance.

refutation_result.description: Adjudicated refutation outcome. Conforms to the machine-readable contract (state transition table plus acceptance matrix) at the end of REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md. SUPERSEDES the historical FR-1 two-outcome result wording rule_falsified | oracle_falsified (see REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md section 0).

state.description: Adjudication state per REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md sections 1-2. UNEXECUTED is the initial state, not a scored outcome.

protocol_completed.description: True only when every protocol step executed to completion within the declared scope.

counterexample_ref.description: Reference to the verified counterexample artifact when state is REFUTED; otherwise null.

missing_evidence_refs.description: When state is INCONCLUSIVE: identifiers of the unobtainable required facts (MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS missing_evidence entries or K1 fact-log refusal rows); otherwise empty.

adjudicated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC adjudication timestamp; null while UNEXECUTED.

validation_status.description: Lifecycle status; allowed values are constrained by refutation_result.state and protocol_completed per REFUTATION_STATE_MODEL.md section 4.

oracle_provenance.description: Origin of the adjudicating oracle: blind (custodian-held, not visible to the solving agent), commit_derived (upstream fix commit), field_log (field incident record), none (no oracle used).

factRef.description: Canonical reference to a FactRecord. This shape is IDENTICAL in FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json, MECHANISM_HYPOTHESIS_SCHEMA.json and RULECARD_SCHEMA.json; source of truth is FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json#/definitions/factRef.

fact_id.description: fact_id of the referenced FactRecord row in the immutable K1 fact log.

trust_class.description: Inherited-trust check: must equal the trust_class recorded in the fact log for fact_id. T1 refs are valid only as K1-mediated claims; T2 refs are never load-bearing (E2).

evidenceSurface.description: Same value set as FACT_RECORD_SCHEMA.json evidence_surface.
